cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(perception_rviz LANGUAGES CXX)
  include(CTest)
endif()
get_filename_component(RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
option(R36_RVIZ_BUILD_PUBLISHER "Build the native X5 SDK display publisher" OFF)
option(R36_RVIZ_BUILD_RECEIVER "Build the Ubuntu ROS2 display receiver" OFF)
option(R36_RVIZ_BUILD_SDK_OUTPUT "Build display adapters for completed SDK results" ${R36_RVIZ_BUILD_PUBLISHER})
option(R36_RVIZ_WITH_HORIZON "Enable the real Horizon stereo provider" ${R36_COMPARE_WITH_HORIZON})
add_library(r36_rviz_settings STATIC src/rviz_settings.cpp)
target_include_directories(r36_rviz_settings PUBLIC include PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/include")
target_compile_features(r36_rviz_settings PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
add_library(r36_rviz_transport STATIC src/rviz_wire.cpp src/rviz_transport.cpp)
target_include_directories(r36_rviz_transport PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(r36_rviz_transport PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(r36_rviz_transport PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
add_executable(r36_rviz_launcher src/rviz_launcher.cpp)
target_link_libraries(r36_rviz_launcher PRIVATE r36_rviz_settings Threads::Threads)
install(TARGETS r36_rviz_launcher RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
if(R36_RVIZ_BUILD_SDK_OUTPUT)
  # Reuse the original display renderer (YUV conversion, class palette and boxes),
  # independently of the SDK's internal, hidden implementation symbols.
  if(NOT TARGET app_support)
    add_library(r36_rviz_render STATIC
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/visualization/backend/src/visualization.cpp"
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/core/runtime/src/error.cpp")
    target_include_directories(r36_rviz_render PUBLIC
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/visualization/backend/include"
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/offline/backend/include"
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/framework/include"
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/core/runtime/include"
      PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/third_party/stb")
    target_compile_features(r36_rviz_render PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
    set(_rviz_renderer r36_rviz_render)
  else()
    set(_rviz_renderer app_support)
  endif()
  add_library(r36_rviz_sdk_output STATIC src/rviz_sdk_output.cpp)
  target_include_directories(r36_rviz_sdk_output PUBLIC include "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/sdk/include"
    PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/include"
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/core/runtime/include"
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/inference/framework/include"
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/visualization/backend/include"
      "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/offline/backend/include")
  target_compile_features(r36_rviz_sdk_output PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_link_libraries(r36_rviz_sdk_output PUBLIC r36_rviz_settings r36_rviz_transport PRIVATE ${_rviz_renderer})
endif()
if(R36_RVIZ_BUILD_PUBLISHER)
  if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The native RViz camera publisher requires Linux")
  endif()
  if(NOT TARGET perception::sdk)
    find_package(perception_full_shared_sdk CONFIG REQUIRED)
  endif()
  if(NOT TARGET r36_motion_features)
    add_subdirectory("${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/visual_motion" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/motion_features")
  endif()
  if(NOT TARGET perception_native_config)
    add_subdirectory("${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/native_config")
  endif()
  if(NOT TARGET slip_timeline)
    add_library(slip_timeline STATIC "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/slip_app/src/slip_timeline.cpp")
    target_include_directories(slip_timeline PUBLIC "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/slip_app/include")
    target_compile_features(slip_timeline PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  endif()
  add_executable(r36_rviz_publisher src/rviz_publisher.cpp "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/camera/src/mo_camera.cpp")
  target_include_directories(r36_rviz_publisher PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/camera/include"
    "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/camera/vendor/mo" "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/core/include"
    "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/compare/runner/include")
  target_link_libraries(r36_rviz_publisher PRIVATE r36_rviz_sdk_output perception_native_config slip_timeline perception::sdk ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
  foreach(directory IN LISTS PSDK_LINK_DEPENDENCY_DIRS)
    target_link_options(r36_rviz_publisher PRIVATE "-Wl,-rpath-link,${directory}")
  endforeach()
  if(R36_RVIZ_WITH_HORIZON)
    find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc imgcodecs)
    include("${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/cmake/nv12.cmake")
    if(NOT TARGET horizon_stereo)
      set(STEREO_BUILD_HORIZON_RUNNER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
      add_subdirectory("${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/stereo/runner" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/horizon_runner")
    endif()
    add_library(r36_rviz_stereo STATIC "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/stereo/src/stereo_provider.cpp")
    target_include_directories(r36_rviz_stereo PUBLIC "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/features/stereo/include"
      PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/compare/runner/include" "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/core/runtime/include")
    target_include_directories(r36_rviz_stereo SYSTEM PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
    target_compile_features(r36_rviz_stereo PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
    target_compile_definitions(r36_rviz_stereo PRIVATE R36_ONLINE_WITH_HORIZON=1)
    target_link_libraries(r36_rviz_stereo PUBLIC perception::sdk stereo_nv12 ${OpenCV_LIBS} PRIVATE horizon_stereo)
    target_link_libraries(r36_rviz_publisher PRIVATE r36_rviz_stereo)
    target_compile_definitions(r36_rviz_publisher PRIVATE R36_RVIZ_WITH_HORIZON=1)
  endif()
  install(TARGETS r36_rviz_publisher RUNTIME DESTINATION lib/perception_ros_so_demo)
endif()
if(R36_RVIZ_BUILD_RECEIVER)
  find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
  find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
  find_package(sensor_msgs REQUIRED)
  find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
  find_package(visualization_msgs REQUIRED)
  add_library(r36_rviz_ros_output STATIC src/rviz_ros_output.cpp)
  target_include_directories(r36_rviz_ros_output PUBLIC include PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/include")
  target_link_libraries(r36_rviz_ros_output PUBLIC r36_rviz_settings r36_rviz_transport)
  ament_target_dependencies(r36_rviz_ros_output PUBLIC rclcpp sensor_msgs std_msgs visualization_msgs)
  add_executable(r36_rviz_receiver src/rviz_receiver.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(r36_rviz_receiver PRIVATE r36_rviz_ros_output)
  ament_target_dependencies(r36_rviz_receiver PUBLIC rclcpp sensor_msgs std_msgs visualization_msgs)
  install(TARGETS r36_rviz_receiver RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  foreach(target r36_rviz_settings r36_rviz_transport r36_rviz_launcher r36_rviz_sdk_output r36_rviz_render)
    if(TARGET ${target})
      target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
if(BUILD_TESTING AND NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
  add_executable(rviz_settings_test "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/rviz_settings_test.cpp")
  target_include_directories(rviz_settings_test PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/include")
  target_link_libraries(rviz_settings_test PRIVATE r36_rviz_settings)
  add_test(NAME rviz_JSON_adb_launcher_contract COMMAND rviz_settings_test "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}" "$<TARGET_FILE:r36_rviz_launcher>")
  add_executable(rviz_transport_test "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/rviz_transport_test.cpp")
  target_link_libraries(rviz_transport_test PRIVATE r36_rviz_transport)
  add_test(NAME rviz_wire_socket_reconnect_contract COMMAND rviz_transport_test)
  if(TARGET r36_rviz_sdk_output)
    add_executable(rviz_sdk_output_test "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/rviz_sdk_output_test.cpp")
    target_link_libraries(rviz_sdk_output_test PRIVATE r36_rviz_sdk_output)
    add_test(NAME rviz_completed_SDK_display_contract COMMAND rviz_sdk_output_test)
  endif()
  if(TARGET r36_rviz_ros_output)
    add_executable(rviz_ros_output_test "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/rviz_ros_output_test.cpp")
    target_include_directories(rviz_ros_output_test PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/include")
    target_link_libraries(rviz_ros_output_test PRIVATE r36_rviz_ros_output)
    ament_target_dependencies(rviz_ros_output_test PUBLIC rclcpp sensor_msgs std_msgs visualization_msgs)
    add_test(NAME rviz_ROS_message_marker_contract COMMAND rviz_ros_output_test)
    add_executable(rviz_end_to_end_test "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/validation/rviz_end_to_end_test.cpp")
    target_include_directories(rviz_end_to_end_test PRIVATE "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/scheduling/config/include")
    target_link_libraries(rviz_end_to_end_test PRIVATE r36_rviz_ros_output)
    ament_target_dependencies(rviz_end_to_end_test PUBLIC rclcpp sensor_msgs std_msgs visualization_msgs)
    add_test(NAME rviz_TCP_ROS_stale_reconnect_contract COMMAND rviz_end_to_end_test)
  endif()
endif()
install(FILES "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/rviz.json" "${RVIZ_PROJECT_ROOT}/rviz_pipeline.json" DESTINATION share/perception_ros_so_demo)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION include/perception_rviz)
